turns.content: For the cylindrical Bessel-function family Y_l^m(theta,phi) with l=0, which values of m are allowed?
Represent the lowest member as a constant C and set up its normalization over the stated angular domain using the appropriate measure.
Evaluate the normalization integral and solve for C using the standard positive real phase.
Give the normalized l=0 spherical harmonic in exact and decimal form, and state its directional dependence.
Explain whether that normalized lowest member depends on direction.
Report the final normalized spherical harmonic using the standard positive real phase convention.
